source.citation: Yutong Yin and Zhaoran Wang, 'Are Transformers Able to Reason by Connecting Separated Knowledge in Training Data?', arXiv:2501.15857v1 [cs.AI], HTML version (v1 banner date 27 Jan 2025).
source.note: Values are author-reported table cells transcribed as printed (3 decimals for metrics; parameter counts as printed, e.g. '54M'). They are not raw runs, seeds, or independently replicated measurements.

experimental_condition.task: FTCT (Fragmented at Training, Chained at Testing)
experimental_condition.M_wording_note: Table 1 caption says 'child chain length upper bound M=3'; Section 4.3 text says 'a child chain length of 3'. Whether M=3 is a fixed length or an upper bound is ambiguous in the source.
experimental_condition.shot_selection: Only the performance of models prompted by CoT with the optimal shots number is shown (Table 1 caption; Section 4.3 paragraph S4.SS3.p1). The source does NOT state the shot count used for any Table 1 row, the candidate shot range, whether the optimum was chosen per model or per metric, or which data/metric determined the optimum. Do not assert a Table 1 shot count.
experimental_condition.aggregation: NOT stated for Table 1: number of runs, seeds, causal-structure resamples, standard deviations and evaluation sample sizes are not reported for this table.

row_id.meaning: Maintainer-assigned stable row key (not in source).

family.meaning: Model family as printed: TF = Transformer (GPT-2-like), MLP = multi-layer perceptron.

config_label.meaning: Configuration label as printed. For TF, 'aLbH' = a layers, b attention heads. For MLP, 'aL' = a layers (the source does not say whether this counts hidden layers only).

layers_reported.meaning: Integer parsed by maintainer from config_label.

heads_reported.meaning: Integer parsed by maintainer from config_label; NA for MLP.

params_reported.meaning: 'Params' column: numbers of parameters of different models, as printed, rounded to millions (M = million). Exact counts not reported.

train_valid_loss.definition: Validation loss: 'tracks the validation loss during training' (Section 4.3 list item S4.I3.ix1). The source does not state the validation data split, normalization (sum vs per-token mean), log base, or the training step at which it was recorded. The training objective (Section 3.3, S3.Ex4; Appendix A.1, A1.Ex1) is a negative log-likelihood summed over shots k and label tokens t.

train_vertices_acc.definition: Training vertices accuracy: how well the model imitates the vertices order from the few-shot examples sampled from D_train (S4.I3.ix2).

train_values_acc.definition: Training values accuracy: whether the model outputs correct values of vertices from child chains, given preceding reasoning paths sampled from D_train (S4.I3.ix3).

test_vertices_acc.definition: Testing vertices accuracy: whether the model correctly outputs all vertices in dec(lab~^k) for (inp~^k, lab~^k) from D_test (S4.I2.ix1; Appendix H.1 A8.I1.ix3).

test_values_acc.definition: Testing values accuracy: whether the model outputs correct values of intermediate vertices given correct preceding reasoning paths sampled from D_test; e.g. prompted with '... A=100, ... B=' the output is accurate iff the next token is '101' for the paper's Figure 1 structure (S4.I2.ix2; A8.I1.ix4).

test_whole_acc.definition: Whole chain accuracy: whether dec(model(inp~^k)) contains all elements of dec(lab~^k) in a correct order (S4.I1.ix1; A8.I1.ix1). Note: the testing loss of Eq. (3.1) uses an exact-equality indicator 1{dec(model(inp~^k)) = dec(lab~^k)}; the source does not state which of the two criteria (contains-in-order vs exact equality) produced the Table 1 column.

cell_locator_convention: Cell ids are the HTML element ids of the <td> cells in the arXiv v1 HTML rendering of Table 1. The first cell id of TF_3L3H and MLP_4L rows is offset by one because the family label cell (rowspan) sits in those rows. Locators are provenance references resolved by reviewers against the original source; the source document itself is not part of the public task assets.
transcription_check: Transcribed by maintainer from the original HTML table cells and re-checked against the original in the repair session; independent re-transcription by a reviewer is pending.
